name: Dr. Dasyam Pallavi
title: Dr. Dasyam Pallavi, Pain Specialist in Hyderabad | Halcyon
meta_description: Dr. Dasyam Pallavi (MBBS, DA, CIPS, FIAPM), Director of Halcyon, Kukatpally: ultrasound-guided pain procedures and cooled RF, without surgery.
summary: Dr. Dasyam Pallavi is a pain management consultant and Director of Halcyon Pain Management Centre in Kukatpally, Hyderabad. She is a Certified Interventional Pain Sonologist (World Institute of Pain) and a Fellow of the Indian Academy of Pain Medicine, with a special interest in musculoskeletal ultrasound-guided procedures and cooled radiofrequency ablation. She examines you, scans you and, when a procedure is right, performs it in the same appointment.

paragraphs: Dr. Pallavi’s background is in anaesthesia, reflected in her DA qualification, which is the route many interventional pain physicians take into pain medicine. The skills overlap closely: the same local anaesthetic medicines and fine needles, aimed at one painful structure rather than the whole body.

Her approach is to find the source of the pain before treating it. She runs the consultation and the diagnostic ultrasound herself, in the same room. Where the scan confirms what the examination suggested, the procedure follows under local anaesthetic, so you stay awake and can tell her what you feel while she works. If the scan points elsewhere, you leave with a different plan rather than a procedure you did not need.
Dr. Pallavi holds the following qualifications and is registered with the Telangana State Medical Council.
bullets: CIPS — Certified Interventional Pain Sonologist, World Institute of Pain
FIAPM — Fellow, Indian Academy of Pain Medicine
Regd. No. 61959, Telangana State Medical Council

paragraphs: Dr. Pallavi’s special interest is musculoskeletal ultrasound-guided procedures and cooled radiofrequency ablation. The CIPS certification she holds from the World Institute of Pain relates to exactly this work: placing a needle where the ultrasound image shows it needs to go.

In practice this covers knee pain treated with the US FDA-cleared COOLIEF cooled radiofrequency system, neck and low back pain where a medial branch block confirms the source before radiofrequency, and ultrasound-guided treatment of joints, tendons and nerves in the shoulder, hip, elbow, wrist, foot and ankle.

sections.h2: How a consultation with Dr. Pallavi works
paragraphs: A consultation follows the same steps as every appointment at Halcyon’s Kukatpally centre. You register, Dr. Pallavi takes your history and examines you, and the painful joint or nerve is scanned with diagnostic ultrasound in the same room. The findings decide the treatment, and if a procedure is right, it is usually done there and then as day care. Most people are home within about two hours of arriving.

Bring any recent X-ray, MRI, CT or ultrasound reports, a list of your medicines and notes from earlier treatment. Tell the team if you take blood thinners, and do not stop any medicine on your own. Costs are given at the consultation, before anything is booked.

faqs.q: What does Dr. Pallavi specialise in?
faqs.a: Dr. Dasyam Pallavi specialises in interventional pain management, with a special interest in musculoskeletal ultrasound-guided procedures and cooled radiofrequency ablation. She is a Certified Interventional Pain Sonologist (World Institute of Pain) and a Fellow of the Indian Academy of Pain Medicine, and she treats knee, spine, joint and nerve pain without surgery.

faqs.q: What do CIPS and FIAPM mean?
faqs.a: CIPS stands for Certified Interventional Pain Sonologist, a certification from the World Institute of Pain in ultrasound-guided interventional pain procedures. FIAPM means Fellow of the Indian Academy of Pain Medicine. Dr. Pallavi also holds an MBBS and a DA (Anaesthesiology), and is registered with the Telangana State Medical Council, Regd. No. 61959.

faqs.q: Will Dr. Pallavi perform the procedure herself?
faqs.a: Yes. At Halcyon the consultant who examines you also performs the diagnostic ultrasound and, if a procedure is indicated, carries it out in the same appointment. Nothing is handed to a second team. Procedures are image-guided and done under local anaesthetic as day care, so you stay awake and go home the same day.

faqs.q: How do I book an appointment with Dr. Pallavi?
faqs.a: Call +91 77880 91092 and ask for Dr. Pallavi by name. Appointments are Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 6 pm, at 3rd Floor, KKR Commercial Complex, Kukatpally Y Junction, Moosapet Road, above the Max showroom. Bring any recent X-ray, MRI or scan reports and a list of your medicines.
